responsibility: Covers the responsibilities of the module files. compiler/rustc_trait_selection/src/errors/note_and_explain.rs: Builds subdiagnostic notes that explain what a lifetime or region refers to in trait-selection errors. It resolves regions to a user-facing description and source span from generic parameter and HIR context, classifies reusable message prefixes and suffixes for fluent diagnostics, and emits the resulting region explanation as a span note or plain note.
